title: zed-http frameworks catalog
description: Languages → frameworks → patterns used to find HTTP routes and calls in source code and generate .http requests. A project can extend it with .zed/http/frameworks.json (merged key by key).

pattern.description: Source code with placeholders: {method} HTTP method (any case) · {path} string contents · {route} string contents starting with / or http(s):// · {host} host name · {name} identifier or header name · {type} type expression · {var} variable (its type is looked up) · {handler} function name (its body is searched) · {keys} a {...}/[...] literal (keys or destructured names) · {generic} optional <...> · {_} any identifier · {x?} optional placeholder · ... anything on the line except parentheses · " any quote · whitespace = optional whitespace · ? optional ? · leading ^ = line start · {{ }} literal braces.

method.description: Method when the pattern has no {method}. Default GET.

url.description: URL template from captures, e.g. https://{host}{path}. Default: {path} or {route}.

prefixed.description: Apply the framework prefix. Default true.

weak.description: Low-confidence match: code action only, no lens.

imports.description: The framework is active only if the file contains one of these strings. Empty = always.

prefix_scope.description: class: an annotation right above a class declaration (default). file: the first match in the file.

controller_token.description: Token in the prefix replaced by the controller class name without the Controller suffix, e.g. [controller].

routes.description: At one position the first matching pattern wins.

query.description: Query parameters: capture {name} (+ {type}), {keys}, {var} or a model {type}.

body.description: JSON body: capture a model {type}, a {var}, {keys} or single fields {name}.

params.description: Handler signature parameters {name}: {type}; models go to the body, scalars to the query (FastAPI-style).

ignore.description: Parameters {name} that are neither query nor body (dependencies, request objects).

examples.description: Checked by the test suite: every route found in code (for this framework) as METHOD URL.

zed.description: Zed language names; the language server must be registered for them in extension.toml.

extensions.description: File extensions without the dot; "*" applies to every file.

decorators.description: Line prefixes of annotations/attributes, e.g. @ or #[.

definitions.description: Lines starting a function; patterns with {handler} also find a handler by name.

handler_refs.description: How a route line references its handler, capturing {handler}.

block.description: Body delimiter; a ( right after the name is read as a constructor/record parameter list.

modifiers.description: Words stripped from the start of field lines.

types.description: Type names (case-insensitive, last path segment) mapped to JSON sample values.

wrappers.description: Generic wrappers unwrapped to their first type argument (Optional<T>, Json<T>…).

auth.description: Global auth markers for every framework.
